status.title: Status
status.description: checked (charged), unreachable, robots_inaccessible, invalid_input or skipped_charge_limit (all free).

robotsTxtStatus.title: robots.txt HTTP status
robotsTxtStatus.description: HTTP status of robots.txt (404 = no file, every crawler allowed).

robotsTxtFound.title: robots.txt found
robotsTxtFound.description: Whether a real robots.txt file was found (not a 404 or an HTML page).

robotsTxtNote.title: robots.txt note
robotsTxtNote.description: Explanation when there is no usable robots.txt or it was truncated.

checkedPath.title: Checked path
checkedPath.description: Path the rules were evaluated for.

aiAccessVerdict.title: AI access verdict
aiAccessVerdict.description: allows_all_ai, blocks_ai_training_only (training bots blocked, AI search and assistant bots allowed), blocks_some_ai_search, or blocks_all_ai. Googlebot/Bingbot and custom tokens are not counted.

blockedBots.title: Blocked bots
blockedBots.description: Crawlers disallowed from the checked path.

partiallyBlockedBots.title: Partially blocked bots
partiallyBlockedBots.description: Crawlers with their own robots.txt group that allows / but disallows some paths.

allowedBots.title: Allowed bots
allowedBots.description: Crawlers allowed on the checked path.

trainingBotsBlocked.title: Training bots blocked
trainingBotsBlocked.description: How many model-training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...) are blocked.

answerBotsBlocked.title: AI search/assistant bots blocked
answerBotsBlocked.description: How many AI search and user-triggered bots (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-User...) are blocked.

aiSearchAllowed.title: AI search allowed
aiSearchAllowed.description: true when no AI search or assistant bot is blocked, so the site can be cited in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and similar answers.

googlebotAllowed.title: Googlebot allowed
googlebotAllowed.description: Googlebot access (Google Search and AI Overviews).

contentSignal.title: Content signals
contentSignal.description: Content-Signal from robots.txt for all crawlers (Cloudflare format), e.g. {"search":true,"ai-input":true,"ai-train":false}. null if absent.

crawlDelaySecs.title: Crawl delay
crawlDelaySecs.description: Crawl-delay for generic crawlers, if set.

bots.title: Per-bot details
bots.description: [{bot, operator, purpose (training/search/user/search_engine/custom), access (allowed/partial/blocked), allowed, matchedUserAgent, matchedRule}].

llmsTxt.title: llms.txt
llmsTxt.description: {found, url, httpStatus, sizeBytes, title, summary, sections, linkCount, followsSpec, note}. found null = not fetched (disallowed or error).

homepage.title: Page meta robots
homepage.description: {fetched, url, httpStatus, metaRobots, xRobotsTag, noindex, noai, noimageai, note}. A 403 here hints that a firewall blocks bots.

error.title: Reason (free rows)
error.description: Why a site could not be checked.
